title: MultibandEngine, processBlock integration, CMakeLists
description:
Implement MultibandEngine to orchestrate crossover split, per-zone processing, and recombination; wire it into PluginProcessor; and register phase-E sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase E.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §5 (zones, controls, display data needs)
- Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h and Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h public APIs from e.1/e.2
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp prepareToPlay/processBlock order from prior phases (TightCut, ChugStabilizer, parametric Stage A)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h multiband_* parameter IDs
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from phases B–D

Implement Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.h/.cpp:
1. MultibandEngine owns MultibandCrossover and four MultibandZone instances (Weight, Body, Bite, Fizz).
2. prepare/reset forwards to children; process: optional true bypass when engine disabled; else split → apply per-zone solo/mute rules (if any zone soloed, mute non-soloed) → MultibandZone::process each → recombine via complementary sum.
3. Parameter setters or applySettings snapshot covering engine enable, three crossovers, and per-zone §5.4 controls without heap in process.
4. Lightweight getters for zone GR/energy and crossover positions for future GUI (§5.5 data only — no paint).

Wire Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
1. Own MultibandEngine member; prepare/reset with the graph; no heap in processBlock.
2. Insert multiband in the established signal flow at a stage-consistent placement (document position relative to Tight Cut / Chug / parametric bands; prefer a clear Stage/pre-or-post position already implied by ParameterIDs placement fields, defaulting to a single well-defined insertion after input conditioning / stabilizer path and coordinated with existing Stage A — do not duplicate processing).
3. Each block, push APVTS multiband parameters into MultibandEngine; honor global bypass.
4. Disabled engine must be true bypass (no spectral tilt from leftover filters).

CMakeLists.txt:
- Add Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.cpp, MultibandZone.cpp, MultibandEngine.cpp, and tests/MultibandTests.cpp to the correct plugin/DSP and unit-test source lists using existing style. No unrelated target refactors.

Do NOT implement unit test bodies (e.4 owns tests) or rewrite crossover/zone algorithms beyond composition and wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.h and Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.cpp exist and own MultibandCrossover plus four MultibandZone instances
MultibandEngine process path splits, applies zone dynamics/solo-mute, and recombines when enabled; true bypass when disabled
Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp own MultibandEngine, prepare it in prepareToPlay, and run it from processBlock with APVTS multiband_* parameters applied
CMakeLists.txt lists MultibandCrossover.cpp, MultibandZone.cpp, MultibandEngine.cpp, and tests/MultibandTests.cpp on the correct targets
Global bypass and engine-disabled paths do not force permanent multiband filtering
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets
redesign bus sidechain topology or StateManager

allowed: embed MultibandEngine by value on the processor
compose crossover + four zones inside MultibandEngine
parameter snapshot helper local to processBlock
append phase-E sources to existing CMake lists only
forbidden: heap allocate zone buffers per block
implement unit tests in this task
